content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in El Paso

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's eligibility criteria—typically a bachelor's degree plus years of direct project-leadership hours, or equivalent experience without a degree. Verify your qualifications before enrolling to ensure you meet the baseline to apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP course. Our synchronous sessions deliver the full 35 contact hours PMI mandates, covering the PMBOK Guide frameworks and real-world application. Attend from your El Paso location on a schedule that fits your work and personal commitments.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After finishing your coursework, complete the official PMI credential application online. Document your project-management experience, education, and training completion. Pay PMI's exam fee through their portal. Processing typically takes days to weeks; plan your exam date after approval.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Pass the PMP Exam
steps_items.text: Leverage Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice questions, study guides, and instructor feedback—to build confidence. Schedule your proctored exam through Pearson VUE at a test center or via remote proctoring. Sit for the 230-question, four-hour exam and work toward passing on your first attempt.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: PMP certification is valid for three years. Earn and report Professional Development Units (PDUs) throughout your renewal cycle by attending training, conferences, volunteering, or publishing. Renew on time to keep your credential active and competitive in your local job market.
